title: camera recorder shares the live connection; H.264 playback (manual until automated)

clauses.text: A camera that allows one connection shows the live view and records at the same time.

steps.do: Open the live view of a camera that allows a single connection, then start its recording.
steps.expect: The picture keeps showing and the recording starts without an error.

clauses.text: A live view opened before the recording lets the recorder keep the connection when the live view closes.

steps.do: Start the live view, then start recording, then close the live view.
steps.expect: The recording carries on with no error.

clauses.text: A deleted or cut recording ledger is noticed, and its second copy gives the lost lines back.

steps.do: On a test camera only, delete or cut its recording ledger file, then run the recording check. If you cannot find how to run the check, mark cannot-test and say so in the note.
steps.expect: The check says in words that the ledger was deleted or lost some lines, and still reports any cut or missing files.

clauses.text: H.264 recordings play through the video add-on decoder, starting at a picture.

steps.do: With the video add-on installed, play an H.264 recording.
steps.expect: It plays from a picture at once. Without the add-on, it says the video add-on is needed.
